testCases.title: Test 1: Memory Efficient Random Simulation
testCases.objective: Verify that the memory-efficient random simulation runs correctly without errors, detecting any invalid moves.
testCases.boardSetup: Runs a configurable number of random simulations (default 5) with a specified seed (default 1224). Starts from the initial board state.
testCases.expectations: The simulation should complete without errors. It should detect any invalid moves (where LegalActions() and IsValidCheckerMove() disagree). Statistics about game length and termination are reported.
testCases.rulesInvolved: Random game simulation, move validation, memory management, general game rules.
testCases.notes: Visualization shows the standard initial state. Actual simulation runs multiple games.

testCases.title: Test: Run Random Simulation
testCases.objective: Verify that the wrapper function for running random simulations works correctly.
testCases.expectations: The function should successfully call MemoryEfficientRandomSim with the provided parameters.
testCases.notes: This test does not manipulate game state directly, so no board visualization is needed.

testCases.title: Test: Command-Line Argument Parsing
testCases.objective: Verify that command-line arguments are correctly parsed.
testCases.boardSetup: Processes command-line arguments for number of simulations and random seed.
testCases.expectations: The function should correctly parse --num_simulations/-n and --seed/-s arguments, updating the provided variables. It should also handle the --help/-h flag.
testCases.notes: This test does not manipulate game state, so no board visualization is needed.

testCases.title: Test: Main Test Runner
testCases.objective: Verify that the main test runner function correctly coordinates argument parsing and test execution.
testCases.boardSetup: Calls ParseArguments and then RunRandomSimTest with the parsed parameters.
testCases.expectations: The function should successfully parse arguments and then run the simulation test.
testCases.notes: This test does not directly manipulate game state, so no board visualization is needed.

testCases.title: Test: Program Entry Point
testCases.objective: Verify that the main function correctly calls the test runner.
testCases.expectations: The function should successfully call RunRandomSimTests and return 0.
testCases.notes: This test does not directly manipulate game state, so no board visualization is needed.
